import collections
def f(gin):
    h,w=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    bg=[v for r in gin for v in r if v==0]
    if not bg: return [r[:] for r in gin]
    start=None
    for i in range(h):
        for j in (0,w-1):
            if gin[i][j]==0: start=(i,j); break
        if start: break
    visited=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dq=collections.deque([start]); visited[start]=True
    while dq:
        i,j=dq.popleft()
        for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and not visited[a][b] and gin[a][b]==0:
                visited[a][b]=True; dq.append((a,b))
    out=[r[:] for r in gin]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if gin[i][j]==0 and not visited[i][j]: out[i][j]=4
    return out
